Name: Tall Wives - Huge Haley
Author: ViolentFran
Description:
Just like my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42110]Long Leah[/url] mod this one makes Haley tall... and huge!

This mod also changes some aspects of Haley. Haley's hair was changed to better match the wavy hair from the vanilla portrait. She now takes photos with a pink phone instead of a camera, she now has idle poses powered by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42083]Idle Plus Walk[/url], and last but definitely not least, since she is now taller than the player, she will scootch down for kisses and hugs S2...

This mod is still under development, and there are still missing sprites. I will slowly work through the remaining ones. For now, she will revert to smol Haley for missing sprites.
